messages:
Aisha: weekly health for Nimbus  quick summary: WoW tokens +19%, QoQ +41%. Avg spend +9% WoW. p95 latency climbed ~35ms. Error rate 5% (mostly 429/503).
Marco: good call out. Is the traffic concentrated by route or scattered?
Aisha: concentrated on /v1/generate and a custom rerank endpoint. Two keys show the majority: key_nimbus_main and key_nimbus_batcher.
ops-bot: [ALERT] Account acct_nimbus - 5m 429 rate = 5.2% (threshold 3%). Dashboard: https://dd.example.com/d/nimbus/health
Sam: I looked at ingress patterns  we have parallel bursts at 10:45-11:20 UTC yesterday with many short-lived streams. KV-cache hit rate drops during those windows.
Priya: did they change model or rollout new features? QoQ token growth suggests a product change.
Aisha: product team rolled out a recap feature beginning last month. Also switched default model to rdx-3-small two weeks ago.
Marco: rdx-3-small has higher mem footprint; could explain latency. Also, if clients open many parallel streams, KV cache benefits drop.
Priya: recommend immediate mitigations: 1) request clients lower concurrency to 3, 2) enable prefix caching on /v1/generate, 3) set a soft rate limit on non-critical keys.
Sam: I'll prepare the telemetry slices to show tokens by route, hour, and API key. Quick query I ran: 
```
SELECT api_key, route, SUM(tokens) as tokens, COUNT(*) as calls, APPROX_QUANTILES(latency_ms, 100)[OFFSET(95)] as p95
FROM `redwood.telemetry.events`
WHERE account_id = 'acct_nimbus' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY api_key, route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Sam: top rows: key_nimbus_main /v1/generate = 58% tokens, key_nimbus_batcher /v1/rerank = 22% tokens, rest <10%.
Aisha: ok. Action items: Marco -> draft client concurrency guidance, Priya -> SDK snippet + prefix-cache config, Sam -> artifact with per-route token/time heatmap, Jules -> cost delta for switching some routes to rdx-2-medium.
Jules: I'll model two options: 1) drop non-critical rerank to rdx-2-medium (est savings ~18%/mo), 2) keep current model but enforce batching/caching (savings ~12% with lower latency).
Priya: sample SDK patch to suggest to their devs:
```js
// reduce concurrency and enable batching window
const client = new RedwoodClient({concurrency:3, batchWindowMs:30, enablePrefixCache:true});
```
Aisha: thanks. Also propose 30m enablement session to walk their engineers through best practices. Availability: Wed 15:00 UTC or Thu 10:00 UTC. Which works?
Marco: Thu 10:00 UTC OK for me.
Sam: Thu 10:00 fine. I can share traces + heatmap in the session.
Jules: once we have their acceptance I'll produce a cost/impact doc for the AE ahead of renewal talk.
Aisha: please attach telemetry snippets to ticket RED-4321 and cc the AE. I'll follow up if we see error rate >6% before Thu. Closing for now 44d
